marta: quick question — we're considering splitting the internal RoutingPolicy API into two surfaces: a thin SDK-facing header/handshake and a richer console-only policy object. thoughts?

alex: why split? what's the main pain?

marta: mainly to reduce churn for client libs. the console wants to attach rich rollout metadata (canary %, tags, cost-priority) that would force SDK bumps. SDKs only need route hint + quota bucket + sampling flag.

sam: i worry about telemetry gaps. if SDKs only send a header like `X-RW-Route: v1;bucket=web` we'll lose structured policy fields for console dashboards unless we duplicate ingestion.

jin: agree with sam. can we keep SDK header minimal but add a platform-side enrich step that maps header -> policy in observability? then console shows full policy.

priya: UX-wise, customers expect to see which rollout is live and why fallback happened. console needs a stable id. so SDKs should at least send a stable `policy_id`. small string, no big surface.

oliver: from runtime POV we can accept either: new `route` header or legacy `route-meta`. plan: support both for 3 months, auto-translate on the server. code snippet for header we discussed:
```
X-Redwood-Route: policy=v2-2026-03;bucket=low;sample=0.02
```
This keeps SDK change minimal.

ryan: what about quota accounting? quota engine currently keys on client-provided `quota_bucket`. If SDKs omit, we'll default to `general` and screw billing/limits. need a migration plan.

marta: proposal: SDKs (py/ts/go) add `policy_id` + optional `quota_bucket`. server enriches to full policy JSON for observability. fallback: if only `quota_bucket` present we use it.

sam: can we add a telemetry opt-in header so console can sample full policy metadata only for opted requests? `X-RW-Telemetry: full` otherwise `minimal`. avoids huge telemetry costs.

telemetry-bot: note: sampling header will be recorded in trace logs. please ensure privacy review for `full` payload.

alex: SDK break risk — how do we land this non-disruptively? prefer feature-flagged rollout in SDKs: default sends legacy header; new minor SDK releases can opt-in to `policy_id` header behind a flag.

priya: also add console UX: show a note on rollout tiles when policy metadata is inferred rather than provided by client. avoids surprise.

marta: action items:
- oliver: implement server-side enrich + dual-header support (ETA 2w)
- jin & sam: design telemetry sampling and storage cost estimate (ETA 1w)
- devex (me) & priya: SDK flagging plan and docs (py/ts/go) (ETA 2w)
- ryan: quota fallback behavior doc + billing implications (ETA 3d)

deploy-bot: scheduled canary for server enrich feature on infra-staging at 2026-03-15T10:00Z

alex: +1. keep breaking changes out of stable SDK minor releases. prefer opt-in first, then default after 6 weeks of canary + metrics.

marta: thanks all — will draft a short RFC + rollout calendar and ping this thread. :thumbsup:
